lines.en: Oh, I think we are lost.
lines.ko: 아, 우리 길을 잃은 것 같아요.

lines.en: Don't worry, Grandma. Which direction is home?
lines.ko: 걱정 마세요, 할머니. 집은 어느 방향이에요?

lines.en: Home is north. Is the sun in the west?
Yes. It's evening, so the sun is in the west.
Then north is on our right.
This morning we came from that corner.
lines.ko: 오늘 아침에 우리는 저 모퉁이에서 왔어요.

lines.en: Good. Is our house near or far?
It's near. Let's turn right at the corner.
You are so good. I will follow you.
We will be home soon, Grandma.
lines.ko: 할머니, 우리 곧 집에 도착할 거예요.

lines.en: Hi. Do you need some help?
Yes, please. Which way is the station?
Go straight, then turn right at the corner.
Right at the corner. Is it far?
No, it's near. Then turn left at the bank.
lines.ko: 아니요, 가까워요. 그다음 은행에서 왼쪽으로 도세요.

lines.en: I walked south for an hour this morning.
lines.ko: 오늘 아침에 남쪽으로 한 시간이나 걸었어요.

lines.en: Oh, the station is east, not south.
I see. I will go east now.
Good. You will find it soon.
Thank you so much, Ma'am.
